recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed unless a future PC work-group decision changes CarePlan doNotPerform/prohibited rationale modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-11345 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification CarePlan request to add CarePlan.activity.detail.prohibited.reason; the accepted resolution was not to add a new element and instead to update CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonCode so it also explains the reason an activity was prohibited.
initial_application: Historical commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9 explicitly listed #11345 and changed CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonCode short and definition text to include the prohibited-rationale wording requested by the resolution.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has evolved from CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonCode/prohibited to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.reason/doNotPerform, with reason represented as CodeableReference and mapped to Request.reason. Later Jira FHIR-14818 resolved no-change on a claim that the same reasonCode element was redundant with Goal.description, reinforcing that the activity rationale element remains distinct.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml already says CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.reason explains why an activity should be done or why it was prohibited, while plannedActivityDetail.doNotPerform carries the current prohibition flag.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change issue about CarePlan.activity.detail.reasonCode redundancy confirms the rationale element remained distinct from Goal.description and retained the prohibited-reason wording.
